heroLead: West Leechburg sits along the Kiskiminetas River in northern Westmoreland County, a former steel town where mineral ownership quietly outlasted the mills.
intro: The mills that once ran along the Kiskiminetas are mostly gone now, but the land underneath West Leechburg kept its value in a different way once Marcellus operators started leasing this part of Westmoreland County. A lot of families here own mineral rights on parcels their grandparents never expected to matter this much.
We come from that same kind of place, land that got passed down without much thought about what was under it, until suddenly it was worth a conversation.

sections.heading: From Steel Town to Gas Lease
paragraphs: West Leechburg's industrial history means a lot of the surrounding land was subdivided and resold multiple times over the last century, which complicates mineral title in ways a rural farm tract usually doesn't have. Tracing exactly who holds the mineral rights on a small borough lot here can take real courthouse work.
We do that work before we make an offer, so you know the number we give you reflects your actual, confirmed interest, not a guess.

sections.heading: What Westmoreland County Wells Have Looked Like
paragraphs: Westmoreland County's Marcellus activity has been steady rather than explosive compared to counties further south and west, with operators like CNX and EQT active in the area over the years. Wells here tend to be tied into multi-well pads that share infrastructure, which affects how quickly your specific unit gets developed and how production shows up on your statement.
We look at the actual production history tied to your unit rather than assuming West Leechburg behaves like the busier core counties.

sections.heading: Getting Past a Confusing Statement
paragraphs: If your royalty statement lists deductions you don't recognize, gathering, compression, marketing, that's standard post-production cost language under most Pennsylvania leases, not necessarily an error. We'll walk through it with you and tell you honestly what it means for your check going forward.

faqs.question: Is West Leechburg part of an active Marcellus unit?
faqs.answer: Activity in northern Westmoreland County has been more moderate than the county's southern and western portions, so we check your specific unit and production history before making an offer.

faqs.question: My mineral rights lot is small, does that matter?
faqs.answer: We buy small and fractional interests regularly. Size alone doesn't disqualify a parcel; we look at the actual decimal interest and production tied to it.

faqs.question: How do you confirm ownership on an old borough lot?
faqs.answer: We trace the chain of title through the Westmoreland County recorder of deeds, which can take extra research on subdivided industrial-era land but is standard work for us.
